name: Donal

facts.text: Donal: level 50, model 304, at about 403,800/759,500 in the eastern Bog of Cullen.
Ide (52), Donal (50), Deniela, Jannet and Manius (48) stand together at about 404,000/759,200 in the eastern Bog of Cullen (z 4,944), all plain spawns with an 80-second respawn.
Living Server lore: Donal as the captain of the Cullen outlaws, an Ardee spearman who killed a man at the muster and went into the bog.

story:
On the eastern edge of the Bog of Cullen, where the marsh gives onto a low island of firm ground, there is a camp that the people of Alainn Binn call the Cullen outlaws. It has been there for a generation: mainland men and women who could not stay in Ardee or Howth or Connacht for one reason or another, and went into the bog where the realm does not follow, and kept going until they reached ground that would hold a fire. They do not rob the villages. They do not trade with them either. They fight anyone who comes onto their island, and the villages have learned to leave them alone.

Donal is their captain, because somebody has to be and he was the one who found the island. He was a spearman of Ardee, the Alainn Binn folk say, the year the Cullen watch was first set at the foot of the Sheeroe pass, and he killed a man at the muster over something that was said about his sister, and walked out of the watch-house before the captain could have him taken. He went into the bog because nobody would follow him there, and he walked until the ground held, and lit a fire, and others who could not go home found the fire.

He runs the camp the way the Cullen watch is run, which the watch finds funny and he does not: there is a tally of who came in and when, a watch on the island's edges every night, and a bell, which is a cracked pot struck with a spear-butt, three slow strokes for strangers on the firm ground. Deniela, Jannet and Manius keep the edges with him. Ide keeps them alive. Saemus kept the bog off them for one summer, and Donal has not forgiven himself for letting him go to the siabra for it.

The Cullen watch knows exactly where he is and has never come for him. The old watch captains say it is because the outlaws on the eastern edge of the bog are a second watch that costs the realm nothing: nothing comes out of the eastern marsh toward Alainn Binn without passing Donal's fire first. Donal says that is not why he keeps the watch, and the old captains say that it does not matter why.
legend: Donal (50) is the captain of the Cullen outlaws on the eastern edge of the Bog of Cullen (about 404k/759k), standing with Ide (52) and Deniela, Jannet and Manius (48). Expect several at once; pull from the edges or bring CC. Plain mobs, no scripts, 80-second respawns. Not a quest target in this world's data, but Ide beside him is (Unnatural Powers), so you will meet him there. The old Cullen watch captains call his camp the second watch: nothing comes out of the eastern marsh without passing it. Come in from the Alainn Binn side, and rest before the pull: five named on one island hit hard.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: the outlaws' island, again, because my grandson asked who Donal is. He was a spearman of Ardee the year the Cullen watch was set, and he killed a man at the muster over something said about his sister, and walked into the bog before he could be taken. He found firm ground and lit a fire. He keeps it like the watch: a tally, a night watch, a cracked pot struck three times for strangers. The watch has never come for him. The old captains say nothing comes out of the eastern marsh without passing his fire.
